title: Learning a Poem Line by Line
short: Build up a poem cumulatively: learn line 1, then lines 1 and 2, then 1 to 3, always reciting from the start before adding.
trouble: Learning each line alone, so the joins between lines never get practiced.

practice.q: A stanza has 4 lines. With cumulative rounds, how many lines will you say in all?
practice.title: Worked example

blocks.html: A good way to learn verse is cumulative: each new line joins the lines before it.
Say from the start each round. The joins between lines get the most practice.

blocks.title: Worked example
blocks.q: A stanza has 4 lines. With cumulative rounds, how many lines will you say in all?

blocks.html: Then space the stanza: recite it on days 1, 3, 7 and 21. Add a new stanza only when the old one is solid.
